name: Bioneer Corporation
summary: Bioneer Corporation, established in 1992 and headquartered in Daejeon, South Korea, is a biotechnology company involved in diverse fields such as research products, molecular diagnostics, pharmaceuticals, and probiotics. For the biotechnology research market, Bioneer offers a wide array of consumables and reagents, including PCR and RT-PCR kits, real-time PCR solutions, RNA interference products, various chemicals, plastic laboratory essentials, and buffer solutions. The company also provides an extensive range of services like sample preparation, protein synthesis and purification, gene cloning, fluorescence dye and quencher services, electrophoresis, genome-wide functional analysis, and magnetic separation techniques. Additionally, Bioneer manufactures sophisticated instruments for conventional and real-time PCR, sample preparation, protein synthesis, centrifugation, vortex mixing, electrophoresis, spectrophotometry, and microbial culture. In molecular diagnostics, it supplies MDx technologies, human diagnostic kits, MDx extraction kits, and the necessary instrumentation. Furthermore, Bioneer develops specialized products for animal health and cutting-edge nano-biotechnology applications.
